drawings.description: feuille de croquis au crayon. En haut à droite « McL » et « $\times M'U$ », une lettre « A ». À gauche, un morphisme $X \to k$ et $k \to Y$ en équerre, puis $X' \to X$ avec une flèche oblique $X' \to k$ marquée \uncertain{« $\phi$ »}. En bas, deux esquisses $Y \to X$ au-dessus de $k$ et $Y' \to X'$ au-dessus de $k'$, une flèche $k \to k'$ barrée d'un petit cercle hachuré ; à droite un carré $X \leftarrow X$, $K$, $k'$, $k \leftarrow K$, un $X$ entouré.
drawings.kind: sheet of pencil sketches of arrow diagrams
drawings.notes: Whole-page pencil sheet, drawn as the page is rendered (upright). Top left: Y -> Y over K, X -> X with the right X ringed, verticals and an arc below; top middle: an up arrow, a horizontal stroke through a small hatched circle, two strokes down to X <- lambda; top right: Y over X <- Lambda with an oblique; two long horizontal strokes at the top right. Bottom: the square X -> X (thick arrow c), up arrows f, Lambda -> Lambda (gamma), an arc below; at the right X <- X with a long oblique and phi, lambda -- Y over X. The letters are read off faint pencil and are uncertain (Y, Lambda, K may be k, A...). The words "A" and "x M'U", "McL" are upside down on the page (bottom left): drawn rotated.
drawings.disagreement: The transcription places "McL", "x M'U" and "A" at the top right: on the render they are upside down at the bottom left, i.e. the transcription read the sheet turned 180 degrees, while the arrow diagrams are written upright; its left/right/top/bottom are therefore not those of the render. The letters of the diagrams (X, k, Y, K) read differently in places (Y, Lambda).

drawings.description: un cercle traversé d'un diamètre horizontal, un point au centre.
drawings.notes: A circle (stroke doubled at the upper left), a horizontal diameter, a heavy point at the centre.

drawings.description: au bas de la page, un réseau de lignes obliques entrecroisées (une rangée de losanges) sur lequel il a écrit en travers : « Dire », « $X$, $Y$ \uncertain{lisses} », « $F_\bullet$, $G_\bullet$ », « \uncertain{revient} \uncertain{à} \uncertain{dire} … \uncertain{d'habitude} », « $i_!(A_U)$, $j_!(A_V)$ », « $i : U\to X$, $j : V\to X$ », « $U$, $V$ », « \ill{} ». Le dessin et l'écriture paraissent superposés ; l'ordre de lecture n'est pas sûr.
drawings.kind: network of crossing oblique lines (row of lozenges) with words written across
drawings.notes: A row of lozenges made by rising and falling oblique lines, schematised as a regular lattice (eight apexes); the real lines are irregular and their number and spacing are approximate. The words written across are placed roughly where they are: "Dire", "X, Y", F, G, i_!(A_U), j_!(A_V), U, V, i : U -> X, j : V -> X; the uncertain phrase "revient a dire ... d'habitude" and the illegible word are left out.

drawings.description: en marge gauche, le diagramme $T \times_{Z} T' \to T, T' \to X \times_{S} Y = Z$ :
drawings.kind: square diagram of a fibre product
drawings.notes: T x_Z T' at the top, arrows down to T and T', and from these to X x_S Y = Z.
Right triangle, right angle at the top right; the hypotenuse is drawn twice.

drawings.description: deux axes, le long de l'axe horizontal un segment de $0$ à $2d$ marqué de points ; puis un triangle sous une droite de pente $-1$, strié de traits horizontaux, l'abscisse $2d$ marquée.
drawings.kind: axes with a graduated segment; hatched triangle under a line of slope -1
drawings.notes: Above: two axes, along the horizontal one a segment from 0 to 2d with a heavy point at 0, an open point and a small point, an angle mark at 2d. Below: axes, a thin line of slope about -1, a heavier staircase-like edge under it, six horizontal hatching strokes from the vertical axis to the edge, points on the edge, 2d marked on the horizontal axis. The steps of the edge are approximate.

drawings.description: un rectangle dont le coin supérieur droit est marqué $2d$ ; deux axes $(p, q)$, des points sur l'axe horizontal jusqu'à $2d$.
drawings.notes: A rectangle whose upper right corner is a point marked 2d; to the right two axes (q upwards, p to the right), small points on the vertical near the origin and a point at 2d on the horizontal.

drawings.description: un segment marqué $2d$ à son extrémité droite.
drawings.notes: A horizontal segment with a heavy point at its left end and 2d at its right end.

drawings.description: axes $(p, q)$ ; un rectangle de sommets $0$ et $2d$, sa diagonale fortement tracée, la droite $p + q = 0$ prolongée au-delà ; au-dessus, une courte inscription biffée, \uncertain{$q^{4} = q \geq q$}.
drawings.kind: rectangle with heavy diagonal on (p, q) axes
drawings.notes: Vertical axis q and a horizontal line through 0; a rectangle with corners 0 (top left) and 2d (top right and bottom left marked 2d), its diagonal from 0 heavily drawn; a thin line crossing the lower left corner and prolonged beyond the rectangle. The struck inscription above (q^4 = q >= q, uncertain) is drawn grey as a scribble. Which line is p + q = 0 is the transcription's reading.

drawings.description: sous trois des termes de la seconde ligne, des flèches verticales vers $A$ ; sous la première, l'annotation « dualité parfaite triviale (via \uncertain{pureté} …) » ; sous les deux autres, réunies par des arcs, « dualité parfaite ?? ».
drawings.kind: vertical arrows under terms of an exact sequence, with annotations
drawings.notes: Under three terms of the second line (written above; the line itself is text and not redrawn), vertical arrows down to A; under the first, the annotation "dualite parfaite triviale (via purete ...)"; the two others joined by arcs, with "dualite parfaite ??". The annotations are given as in the transcription; a bracket left of the first A is drawn.
